keyword.en: how to inquire Xingtai for Rural Diesel Concrete Pump
keyword.zh: 如何向邢台询盘农村自建房柴油混凝土泵

title.en: Ask Xingtai to price the Rural Diesel Concrete Pump only after the inquiry names output, distance, power and particle size
title.zh: 向邢台询农村自建房柴油混凝土泵的价格前，先写清输送量、距离、动力和粒径

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Rural Diesel Concrete Pump at /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump. Copy only the printed cells: Model Rural Self-Built House Diesel Pump; Diesel Engine Power 17 kW; Theoretical Output 5–8 m³/h; Pumping Pressure 15 MPa; Horizontal Delivery Distance 30–50 m; Vertical Delivery
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把农村自建房柴油混凝土泵列在 /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump。只抄已印格子：型号 Rural Self-Built House Diesel Pump; 柴油机功率 17 kW; 理论输送量 5–8 m³/h; 泵送压力 15 MPa; 水平输送距离 30–50 m; 垂直输送高度 10–30 m; 最大骨料粒径 1–3 cm; 料斗容积 0.2 m³; 外形尺寸 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm; 整机重量 800 kg。运输请抄外形尺寸是 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm，整机重量是 800 kg。已印输送量是 5–8 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方

h1.en: The Rural Diesel Concrete Pump inquiry starts from the printed page
h1.zh: 农村自建房柴油混凝土泵的询盘从已印页面开始

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Rural Diesel Concrete Pump at /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump. Copy only the printed cells: Model Rural Self-Built House Diesel Pump; Diesel Engine Power 17 kW; Theoretical Output 5–8 m³/h; Pumping Pressure 15 MPa; Horizontal Delivery Distance 30–50 m; Vertical Delivery Height 10–30 m; Max. Aggregate Size 1–3 cm; Hopper Capacity 0.2 m³; Dimensions (L×W×H) 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm; Total Weight 800 kg. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm and Total Weight is 800 kg. The printed output cell is 5–8 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. The printed distance row or rows: Pumping Pressure 15 MPa; Horizontal Delivery Distance 30–50 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. The printed power cell is 17 kW. Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. The printed aggregate or particle cell is 1–3 cm. Send the maximum stone or particle size in the mix. If the mix is coarser, this row is the wrong page. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai. The photograph on this note is a content image from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wheelbarrow. It shows: A wheelbarrow rickshaw under the Qing (1895). It is a reference picture for the inquiry topic. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把农村自建房柴油混凝土泵列在 /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump。只抄已印格子：型号 Rural Self-Built House Diesel Pump; 柴油机功率 17 kW; 理论输送量 5–8 m³/h; 泵送压力 15 MPa; 水平输送距离 30–50 m; 垂直输送高度 10–30 m; 最大骨料粒径 1–3 cm; 料斗容积 0.2 m³; 外形尺寸 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm; 整机重量 800 kg。运输请抄外形尺寸是 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm，整机重量是 800 kg。已印输送量是 5–8 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。已印距离行：泵送压力 15 MPa；水平输送距离 30–50 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。已印动力是 17 kW。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。已印骨料或粒径是 1–3 cm。询盘写混合物里的最大石子或粒径。料更粗时，这一行就不是该打开的页面。OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。这篇配图是 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wheelbarrow 页面里的内容图片。画面主体：1895年的独轮手推车。它只作询盘主题的参考。它不是河北品锦机械的铭牌，不是报价单，也不是出口案例。

body.en: Put /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump in the subject. The published cells are: Model Rural Self-Built House Diesel Pump; Diesel Engine Power 17 kW; Theoretical Output 5–8 m³/h; Pumping Pressure 15 MPa; Horizontal Delivery Distance 30–50 m; Vertical Delivery Height 10–30 m; Max. Aggregate Size 1–3 cm; Hopper Capacity 0.2 m³; Dimensions (L×W×H) 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm; Total Weight 800 kg. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.
body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump。已公布的格子是：型号 Rural Self-Built House Diesel Pump; 柴油机功率 17 kW; 理论输送量 5–8 m³/h; 泵送压力 15 MPa; 水平输送距离 30–50 m; 垂直输送高度 10–30 m; 最大骨料粒径 1–3 cm; 料斗容积 0.2 m³; 外形尺寸 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm; 整机重量 800 kg。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Output, distance, power and particle size
heading.zh: 输送量、距离、动力和粒径

body.en: The printed output cell is 5–8 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. The printed distance row or rows: Pumping Pressure 15 MPa; Horizontal Delivery Distance 30–50 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. The printed power cell is 17 kW. Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. The printed aggregate or particle cell is 1–3 cm. Send the maximum stone or particle size in the mix. If the mix is coarser, this row is the wrong page.
body.zh: 已印输送量是 5–8 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。已印距离行：泵送压力 15 MPa；水平输送距离 30–50 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。已印动力是 17 kW。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。已印骨料或粒径是 1–3 cm。询盘写混合物里的最大石子或粒径。料更粗时，这一行就不是该打开的页面。

heading.en: What to ask Xingtai instead of guessing
heading.zh: 该问邢台，而不是自己猜

body.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. Also send country and purchase timing as facts about your order. Do not turn them into a promised lead time or an export-country list. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
body.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。同时把国家和采购时间作为订单事实发来。不要把它们写成承诺交期，也不要写成出口国名单。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

body.en: The photograph on this note is a content image from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wheelbarrow. It shows: A wheelbarrow rickshaw under the Qing (1895). It is a reference picture for the inquiry topic. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case.
body.zh: 这篇配图是 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wheelbarrow 页面里的内容图片。画面主体：1895年的独轮手推车。它只作询盘主题的参考。它不是河北品锦机械的铭牌，不是报价单，也不是出口案例。

question.en: Is a price printed for the Rural Diesel Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 农村自建房柴油混凝土泵印了价格吗？

answer.en: No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
answer.zh: 产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

question.en: Can OEM numbers be guessed from a similar machine?
question.zh: OEM 数字能按相似机器猜吗？

answer.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print.
answer.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。

answer.en: It shows: A wheelbarrow rickshaw under the Qing (1895). It is the content image from the source article, not a Pinjin nameplate.
answer.zh: 画面主体：1895年的独轮手推车。它是来源文章里的内容图片，不是品锦铭牌。
